workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad, I've cross-referenced our lists, and it seems we don't have a clear slot. However, I've noticed that on Monday at 11:00 AM, Marcus is free, and Priya has a "Travel" block. This might be flexible. Can you check if Elena and David are still free at 11:00 AM on Monday? If so, I can try to get that time freed up on Priya's calendar.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, thanks for checking. Yes, I can confirm that Monday at 11:00 AM works for both Elena and David. Please go ahead and see if you can get that time freed up with Priya. If you can, please book it. Once the meeting is booked, I will send the confirmation email. Thanks, Brad.
